links.outcome: Reading grade level of original online patient education materials versus sixth-grade recommendation
links.effect: Original mean grade levels were 10.7 (AHA), 10.0 (ACS), and 9.6 (ASA), all above the recommended sixth-grade level.
links.quote: The original readability scores for the American Heart Association (AHA), American Cancer Society (ACS), and American Stroke Association (ASA) websites were above the recommended sixth-grade level, with mean grade level scores of 10.7,10.0, and 9.6, respectively.

links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified patient education materials versus originals (average grade level)
links.effect: Average grade level improved from 10.1 to 7.6 (ChatGPT), 6.6 (Gemini), and 5.6 (Claude), all P<.001; understandability (PEMAT-U) largely preserved.
links.quote: Compared with the original website, ChatGPT improved the readability to 7.6 from 10.1 ( P <.001); Gemini, to 6.6 ( P <.001); and Claude, to 5.6 ( P <.001).

links.outcome: Inaccuracies in LLM-simplified patient education materials versus original content
links.effect: ChatGPT 0/60 inaccurate; Gemini 2/60 (3.3%) and Claude 2/60 (3.3%) inaccurate, e.g., 'Tiny heart trouble' for coronary microvascular disease.
links.quote: ChatGPT had no inaccuracies on all 3 sites, while Gemini experienced 2 inaccuracies on the AHA website and Claude experienced one inaccuracy on the ACA and one on the ASA website.

links.effect: Only Claude consistently achieved fifth-grade level on all 3 websites (5.5-5.9); Gemini on one website; ChatGPT on none.
links.quote: Of LLM-simplified versions of the PEM, only Claude consistently achieved a mean fifth-grade reading level on all 3 websites (5.5-5.9), while Gemini did on one of the websites, and ChatGPT on none.

links.quote: None of the ChatGPT LLM-simplified PEMs were inaccurate, while 3.3% of Gemini and Claude LLM-simplified PEMs were inaccurate.
